sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedanta.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔。

sentences.en: In 2005, an audience filed into the Brava Theatre Center in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 2005年，三藩市布拉瓦剧院中心走入了一批观众。

sentences.en: The house lights were on, making it easy to see a small group of men already on stage,
sentences.zh: 剧场内灯火通明，让人一眼就能看到舞台上的一小群男人，

sentences.en: wearing orange jumpsuits and lying on small prison cots.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着橙色连体囚服，躺在小小的监狱行军床上。

sentences.en: They were actors in the politically charged play, Guantanamo, honor bound to defend freedom.
sentences.zh: 他们是政治色彩浓厚的戏剧《关塔那摩》中的演员，肩负着捍卫自由的使命。

sentences.en: The show told the stories of four British Muslim detainees.
sentences.zh: 该剧讲述了四名英国穆斯林被扣押人员的故事。

sentences.en: The narrative unfolds through the testimony of their families, attorneys and U.S.
sentences.zh: 故事通过他们的家属、律师以及美国

sentences.en: officials,
sentences.zh: 官员的证词缓缓展开，

sentences.en: along with letters that the men wrote while being held at Guantanamo Bay in Cuba.
sentences.zh: 还有这些人在古巴关塔那摩湾被关押期间写下的信件。

sentences.en: One of them was a guy named Ruhal Ahmed, who was from an area outside of Birmingham.
sentences.zh: 其中一人名叫鲁哈尔·艾哈迈德，来自伯明翰郊区。

sentences.en: And him and three of his buddies were picked up in Afghanistan and were held in Guantanamo Bay for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 他和他的三个好哥们在阿富汗被捕，在关塔那摩湾被关押了整整多年。

sentences.en: This is Nafis Hamid.
sentences.zh: 这是纳菲斯·哈米德。

sentences.en: He played the role of Ruhal in one production of the play.
sentences.zh: 他在该剧的一个版本中饰演了鲁哈尔的角色。

sentences.en: What I remember from being in that show was just the way in which his letters were quite spirited in the beginning.
sentences.zh: 我对那场演出印象最深刻的是，他的信在刚开始时充满了活力。

sentences.en: He would be talking about how all the Guantanamo Bay guards like him, how they get along.
sentences.zh: 他会谈到关塔那摩湾的警卫们有多喜欢他，他们相处得有多好。

sentences.en: They call him Slim Shady, how he's working on a six-pack.
sentences.zh: 他们叫他“阿姆”，说他正在练腹肌。

sentences.en: And then by the end, his letters, you could just see, were getting more and more depressed.
sentences.zh: 然后到了后来，你会发现他的信变得越来越沮丧。

sentences.en: And you could just tell that this was someone who was entering into a dark and very, very negative state.
sentences.zh: 你一眼就能看出，这是一个正在陷入黑暗且非常非常负面状态的人。

sentences.en: Ruhal Ahmed was accused of being an al-Qaeda recruit, an enemy of the United States.
sentences.zh: 鲁哈尔·艾哈迈德被指控为基地组织的新兵、美国的敌人。

sentences.en: Throughout his more than two-year stint in Guantanamo, he maintained that he was innocent.
sentences.zh: 在关塔那摩呆了两年多的时间里，他一直坚称自己是无辜的。

sentences.en: He was eventually released without charges.
sentences.zh: 他最终在没有被起诉的情况下获释。

sentences.en: As an actor, Nafis felt his job was to inhabit the prisoner's life and character.
sentences.zh: 作为一名演员，纳菲斯觉得自己的职责是融入囚犯的生活和性格。

sentences.en: With any character that you play, you know, whether they're innocent or guilty,
sentences.zh: 对于你扮演的任何角色，你知道，无论是无辜的还是有罪的，

sentences.en: you try not to judge them and try to just become one of them as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 你都要尽量不去评判他们，并尽可能地与他们融为一体。

sentences.en: It was not the last time Nafis would try to get into the mind of a suspected terroriSt.
sentences.zh: 这并不是纳菲斯最后一次试图走入疑似恐怖分子的内心世界。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we dive into the motivations of people on the brink of extremism
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》中，我们将深入探讨处于极端主义边缘的人们的动机

sentences.en: and those who have been radicalized.
sentences.zh: 以及那些已经被极端化的人。

sentences.en: We examine what prompts people to turn to violence
sentences.zh: 我们审视是什么促使人们转向暴力，

sentences.en: and explore how psychological science might pull people back
sentences.zh: 并探讨心理科学如何能够将人们

sentences.en: from the seductive appeal of extremist ideas.
sentences.zh: 从极端主义思想的诱惑中拉回来。

sentences.en: After a few more years in the performing arts,
sentences.zh: 在表演艺术领域又呆了几年之后，

sentences.en: Nafis Hamid left acting to pursue a career in psychology.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯离开演艺界，转而追求心理学事业。

sentences.en: I always just had an interest in human psychology and what motivates us.
sentences.zh: 我对人类心理以及是什么在驱动我们一直很感兴趣。

sentences.en: I think that's part of the reason why I also was interested in acting.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是我曾经对表演感兴趣的部分原因。

sentences.en: To me, that's just another way of trying to understand
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这只是另一种试图理解的方式，

sentences.en: a more embodied, more intuitive way of trying to understand human psychology.
sentences.zh: 一种更具具象化、更直观的方式来理解人类心理。

sentences.en: Nafis went on to study cognitive science,
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯后来去学习了认知科学，

sentences.en: but he still craved drama and excitement
sentences.zh: 但他仍然渴望戏剧性和刺激感，

sentences.en: and wanted to get into a field of research that would take him all over the world.
sentences.zh: 并希望进入一个能带他走遍全世界的研究领域。

sentences.en: So he sought out cultural anthropologist and former guest of the show, Scott Atron.
sentences.zh: 于是他找到了文化人类学家、节目的老嘉宾斯科特·阿特兰。

sentences.en: At the time, Scott was studying terrorist groups.
sentences.zh: 当时，斯科特正在研究恐怖组织。

sentences.en: You know, I really wanted to work with Scott and he was,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我真的很想跟斯科特合作，而且他，

sentences.en: I think he probably had some interest in working with me,
sentences.zh: 我想他可能对跟我合作也有些兴趣，

sentences.en: but he, you know, pawned me off to another academic who was there at Oxford
sentences.zh: 但他，你知道的，把我推给了牛津大学的另一位学者，

sentences.en: because that person was maybe more in a position to take on a PhD student.
sentences.zh: 因为那个人可能更有条件招收博士生。

sentences.en: That person tried to pawn me off to another academic at the University of BelfaSt.
sentences.zh: 那个人又试图把我推给贝尔法斯特大学的另一位学者。

sentences.en: Pass the hot potato here.
sentences.zh: 这就像是在击鼓传花。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Living in Belfast and doing research on historical conflict in Northern Ireland
sentences.zh: 住在贝尔法斯特并研究北爱尔兰历史冲突，

sentences.en: was not what Nafis had imagined for himself.
sentences.zh: 并不是纳菲斯为自己想象的生活。

sentences.en: This was in 2013, the Arab Spring.
sentences.zh: 那是2013年，阿拉伯之春爆发的时候。

sentences.en: Pro-democracy protests were spreading across the Middle East and Northern Africa.
sentences.zh: 民主抗议浪潮正在中东和北非蔓延。

sentences.en: Jihadist groups, clusters of violent Islamic militias, were forming at a fast pace.
sentences.zh: 圣战组织，即一群群暴力的伊斯兰民兵，正在迅速形成。

sentences.en: In Syria, young men from around the world were gathering.
sentences.zh: 在叙利亚，来自世界各地的年轻男子聚集在一起。

sentences.en: They wanted to overthrow Syria's authoritarian leader, Bashar al-Assad.
sentences.zh: 他们想要推翻叙利亚的独裁领导人巴沙尔·阿萨德。

sentences.en: They didn't always know what they were fighting for.
sentences.zh: 他们并不总是知道自己在为什么而战。

sentences.en: They weren't necessarily going always to become a jihadist themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们也未必总是打算自己成为一名圣战分子。

sentences.en: But, you know, it was a sort of a sense of like,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这有一种感觉，

sentences.en: this is, for a lot of young Muslim youth,
sentences.zh: 对许多年轻的穆斯林青年来说，

sentences.en: this was their equivalent of being able to say,
sentences.zh: 这相当于他们能够宣称：

sentences.en: this is my hero's journey is about to begin.
sentences.zh: “我的英雄之旅即将开始了。”

sentences.en: I'm going to go, and maybe I'll die,
sentences.zh: “我要去那里，也许我会死，

sentences.en: but I'm going to go fight for the plight of the Muslim people in Syria
sentences.zh: 但我要去为叙利亚穆斯林同胞的苦难而战，

sentences.en: and save them from this brutal dictator.
sentences.zh: 把他们从这个残酷的独裁者手中拯救出来。”

sentences.en: Outside of adventure and curiosity,
sentences.zh: 除了冒险精神和好奇心之外，

sentences.en: Nafis had another motivator for studying radicalized Islamic groups.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯研究极端化伊斯兰组织还有另一个动机。

sentences.en: His own upbringing mirrored that of many of the people Scott was studying.
sentences.zh: 他自己的成长经历与斯科特正在研究的许多人如出一辙。

sentences.en: Nafis was raised Muslim by his Pakistani father and Indian mother,
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯由巴基斯坦父亲和印度母亲抚养长大，信仰伊斯兰教，

sentences.en: and he spoke many of the same languages as the jihadist recruits.
sentences.zh: 他会说许多与圣战新兵相同的语言。

sentences.en: In a way, he felt like he was the perfect candidate for this kind of work.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他觉得自己是做这种工作的绝佳人选。

sentences.en: One day, he made his views known over dinner with Scott and other academics,
sentences.zh: 有一天，在与斯科特和其他学者共进晚餐时，他表达了自己的观点，

sentences.en: perhaps a tad forcefully.
sentences.zh: 语气或许有点强硬。

sentences.en: I was a little drunk, so I said something I probably wouldn't have said,
sentences.zh: 我当时有点喝多了，所以说了一些我平时可能不会说的话，

sentences.en: which is just, are you kidding me?
sentences.zh: 那就是：开什么玩笑？

sentences.en: This is 2013.
sentences.zh: 现在是2013年。

sentences.en: And I'm like, we have right now, you know,
sentences.zh: 我说，我们现在，你知道的，

sentences.en: this huge foreign fighter exodus going on
sentences.zh: 正经历着大规模的外国战斗人员出走潮，

sentences.en: of people who are pretty close to my profile,
sentences.zh: 这些人跟我的情况非常接近，

sentences.en: who are pretty close to my age.
sentences.zh: 他们的年龄也跟我差不多。

sentences.en: They look like me, they speak some of the same languages that I speak,
sentences.zh: 他们长得像我，说一些我也会说的语言，

sentences.en: same kind of background,
sentences.zh: 背景也大同小异，

sentences.en: and they're all going from all, thousands of them from all over the world
sentences.zh: 他们全都从世界各地成千上万地涌向叙利亚，

sentences.en: are going to Syria to go join groups like ISIS and Al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 去加入伊斯兰国和基地组织这样的集团。

sentences.en: And you want me to go to Northern Ireland to hang out with former IRA people?
sentences.zh: 而你却让我去北爱尔兰跟前爱尔兰共和军的人混在一起？

sentences.en: Who's going to go talk to these people?
sentences.zh: 谁来跟这些人对话？

sentences.en: Who's going to be able to relate to them?
sentences.zh: 谁能与他们产生共鸣？

sentences.en: Who's going to be able to put himself in their shoes?
sentences.zh: 谁能设身处地为他们着想？

sentences.en: Like an actor portraying these people eventually absorb their thinking,
sentences.zh: 就像扮演这些人的演员最终会吸收他们的思想一样，

sentences.en: be able to come back and communicate it not only to you,
sentences.zh: 能够回来并把这些传达给你，

sentences.en: but to policymakers and to the media,
sentences.zh: 不仅传达给决策者，还传达给媒体，

sentences.en: so that way people can understand and relate to it
sentences.zh: 这样人们才能理解并产生共鸣，

sentences.en: in order to eventually combat it.
sentences.zh: 从而最终去打击他们。

sentences.en: I said to those researchers,
sentences.zh: 我对那些研究人员说：

sentences.en: you're asking me to operate with one hand tied behind my back.
sentences.zh: 你们这是要求我绑着一只手去工作。

sentences.en: I have more to offer than just being a scientiSt.
sentences.zh: 我的价值不仅仅是一名科学研究员。

sentences.en: Because I have friends who are better scientists than me.
sentences.zh: 因为我有比我更优秀的科学界朋友。

sentences.en: That's what you just want as an academic.
sentences.zh: 那正是你作为一个学术人员想要的。

sentences.en: I'll introduce you to other academics.
sentences.zh: 我可以把你介绍给其他学者。

sentences.en: You don't need me.
sentences.zh: 你根本不需要我。

sentences.en: And I could tell, again, Scott sort of liked the chutzpah
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到，斯科特其实挺欣赏

sentences.en: that I showed in that moment.
sentences.zh: 我当时表现出的那股冲劲。

sentences.en: And that's when he and another person he was working with
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他和他的另一位合作伙伴

sentences.en: offered me a job.
sentences.zh: 给我提供了一份工作。

sentences.en: The job was more of what Nafis had in mind.
sentences.zh: 这份工作更符合纳菲斯的心意。

sentences.en: It involved moving to Spain to find, interview, and perform brain scans
sentences.zh: 它需要搬到西班牙去寻找、采访那些几乎或完全陷入极端伊斯兰组织的男子，

sentences.en: on men nearly or fully entrenched in extremist Islamic groups.
sentences.zh: 并对他们进行脑部扫描。

sentences.en: The research project was designed to evaluate the lengths these men would go
sentences.zh: 这项研究项目的旨在评估这些人为了捍卫心理学家所说的“神圣价值”

sentences.en: to defend what psychologists call sacred values.
sentences.zh: 愿意付出多大的代价。

sentences.en: Yeah, so sacred values are values that are of the utmost importance to us.
sentences.zh: 是的，神圣价值对我们来说是最为重要的价值。

sentences.en: They are values that you cannot engage with them or trade them off
sentences.zh: 这些价值是你无法与之妥协的，也不能为了

sentences.en: for the material aspects of the world.
sentences.zh: 世俗的物质利益而将它们拿去交换。

sentences.en: I can't buy this value off you.
sentences.zh: 我无法用金钱从你这里买走这种价值。

sentences.en: You're going to reject any kind of economic incentive that I make.
sentences.zh: 你会拒绝我提出的任何经济刺激。

sentences.en: There's almost an element of purity to it.
sentences.zh: 它甚至带有一点纯洁的意味。

sentences.en: Nafis wanted to understand what was happening in the minds of people
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯想要理解那些持有神圣价值的人，

sentences.en: who held sacred values.
sentences.zh: 他们的脑海里究竟在想些什么。

sentences.en: But before he could do that, he had to recruit volunteers for the study.
sentences.zh: 但在那之前，他必须为这项研究招募志愿者。

sentences.en: He was working in Barcelona, a city with small, concentrated areas
sentences.zh: 他当时在巴塞罗那工作，那是一座拥有小片集中区域的城市，

sentences.en: known to be breeding grounds for extremists.
sentences.zh: 这些区域被认为是极端分子的滋生地。

sentences.en: Nafis had no idea how to find would-be extremists,
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯不知道该如何寻找潜在的极端分子，

sentences.en: so he drew on his acting background.
sentences.zh: 于是他借鉴了自己的表演背景。

sentences.en: He decided to pretend to be an extremist himself.
sentences.zh: 他决定假装自己也是一个极端分子。

sentences.en: So one of my first ridiculous attempts was that I just went to cafes,
sentences.zh: 所以我的第一个荒谬尝试就是去咖啡馆，

sentences.en: opened up my laptop in like kind of Muslim-dense areas,
sentences.zh: 在穆斯林聚居区之类的咖啡馆里打开笔记本电脑，

sentences.en: downloaded an ISIS video, started to watch that with the volume on full blast,
sentences.zh: 下载一段伊斯兰国视频，然后把音量开到最大开始观看，

sentences.en: thinking that maybe someone might walk behind me and be like,
sentences.zh: 心想可能会有人从我身后走过，然后说：

sentences.en: hey, is that the latest drop?
sentences.zh: “嘿，这是最新发布的视频吗？”

sentences.en: Let's sit down.
sentences.zh: “我们坐下聊聊吧。”

sentences.en: Are you a fan?
sentences.zh: “你是粉丝吗？”

sentences.en: Let's sit down and have a chat.
sentences.zh: “我们坐下来聊聊天吧。”

sentences.en: And luckily, all that happened was that the manager of that cafe,
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，结果只是那家咖啡馆的经理，

sentences.en: who was also Muslim, kicked me out
sentences.zh: 他也是个穆斯林，把我给赶了出去，

sentences.en: and threatened that, you know, I might get the cops called on me
sentences.zh: 并威胁说，如果我再搞这种把戏，

sentences.en: if I pull anything like this again.
sentences.zh: 他就要报警了。

sentences.en: The YouTube videos were not a total loss.
sentences.zh: 不过那些油管视频也并非毫无收获。

sentences.en: Quite a few of them were posted by a man living right outside of Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 其中有不少是一个住在巴塞罗那郊外的人发布的。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, when Nafis reached out and explained his research project,
sentences.zh: 出人意料的是，当纳菲斯联系他并解释了自己的研究项目时，

sentences.en: the man invited him to his apartment.
sentences.zh: 这个人竟然邀请他去了自己的公寓。

sentences.en: I get to his flat and there's already a couple of guys who are there
sentences.zh: 我到了他的公寓，起居室里已经有几个家伙在那儿了，

sentences.en: in the kind of the living space and him and I are talking.
sentences.zh: 我和他正在交谈。

sentences.en: He brings me into the kitchen where he's doing some stuff there
sentences.zh: 他把我带到厨房，他在那里弄点东西，

sentences.en: and we sit down and we start talking.
sentences.zh: 我们坐下来开始交谈。

sentences.en: And we're speaking to each other in French.
sentences.zh: 我们用法语互相交谈。

sentences.en: And, you know, he's telling me about his ideology
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他向我讲述了他的意识形态

sentences.en: and his way of thinking about the world.
sentences.zh: 以及他看待世界的方式。

sentences.en: It's very clear to me very quickly that this guy is supporter
sentences.zh: 我很快就非常清楚地意识到这家伙是

sentences.en: of the sort of global jihadi movement.
sentences.zh: 某种全球圣战运动的支持者。

sentences.en: And we're having this conversation and it's all going fine.
sentences.zh: 我们正在进行这场谈话，一切都很顺利。

sentences.en: But then he starts to get more and more animated.
sentences.zh: 但接着他的情绪开始变得越来越激动。

sentences.en: He asked me where I'm from and I was honeSt.
sentences.zh: 他问我来自哪里，我老实回答了。

sentences.en: I told him I'm American.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他我是美国人。

sentences.en: He knew I was a researcher that I'm trying to study this way of thinking.
sentences.zh: 他知道我是一名研究员，也知道我正试图研究这种思维方式。

sentences.en: And then he starts saying some stuff like, you know,
sentences.zh: 然后他开始说一些话，你知道的，

sentences.en: we can't trust anybody as Muslims were persecuted everywhere we go.
sentences.zh: 比如我们不能信任任何人，因为穆斯林无论走到哪里都在遭受迫害。

sentences.en: And then he says, basically, you know, why should I even trust you?
sentences.zh: 接着他基本上说，你知道的，我凭什么信任你？

sentences.en: You're an American.
sentences.zh: 你是个美国人。

sentences.en: And then he says, why should I even let you out of my flat?
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我凭什么放你离开我的公寓？

sentences.en: And that's when I realized, OK, things are really turning sideways here.
sentences.zh: 就在那时我意识到，好吧，事情在这里真的开始不对劲了。

sentences.en: Nafis decided to appeal to the young man's vanity, his desire to be an influencer.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯决定利用这个年轻人的虚荣心，利用他想成为网红的渴望。

sentences.en: Listen, I saw your YouTube channel.
sentences.zh: 听着，我看了你的YouTube频道。

sentences.en: No one's watching your videos.
sentences.zh: 根本没人看你的视频。

sentences.en: You know, you had like 68 views.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你大概只有68次播放。

sentences.en: You have like whatever, like 200 followers or something.
sentences.zh: 你大概有随便吧，大概200个粉丝之类的。

sentences.en: I am a researcher.
sentences.zh: 我是一名研究员。

sentences.en: My articles will be published in, you know, major academic journals.
sentences.zh: 我的文章将会发表在，你知道的，各大学术期刊上。

sentences.en: I have the potential to if I can understand you, I have the potential to get your message
sentences.zh: 如果我能理解你，我有可能，我有潜力将你的信息

sentences.en: out to a broader audience.
sentences.zh: 传达给更广泛的受众。

sentences.en: I'm not here to be your mouthpiece, but I can at least, you know, communicate what you think
sentences.zh: 我来这里不是当你的传声筒，但我至少可以，你知道的，把你的想法

sentences.en: and your ideas to a wider audience because you can't do it on your own.
sentences.zh: 和你的观点传达给更广泛的受众，因为你自己做不到这一点。

sentences.en: And you're not doing, you're not succeeding on your own.
sentences.zh: 而且你也没有在做，你靠自己并没有成功。

sentences.en: And he kind of laughed it off.
sentences.zh: 他有点把这当成玩笑笑过去了。

sentences.en: He thought that was a little funny.
sentences.zh: 他觉得这有点搞笑。

sentences.en: And he was like, all right, fine.
sentences.zh: 他当时想，好吧，行吧。

sentences.en: And then he then just continued on with the conversation.
sentences.zh: 然后他就接着把对话进行下去了。

sentences.en: But I could tell there was something that's off now.
sentences.zh: 但我也能看出，现在有些地方不对劲了。

sentences.en: It's not really the same dynamic.
sentences.zh: 互动氛围已经完全不一样了。

sentences.en: He leaves the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他离开了厨房。

sentences.en: He leaves me there.
sentences.zh: 他把我留在那儿。

sentences.en: And I hear him in the other room speaking to these two guys in the region.
sentences.zh: 我听到他在另一个房间里和当地的另外两个人说话。

sentences.en: Nafis spoke Urdu, which shares some words with the region.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯会说乌尔都语，这种语言与当地语言有一些相同的词汇。

sentences.en: As he eavesdropped on the men in the next room, one word kept popping out.
sentences.zh: 当他在隔壁房间偷听这几个男人说话时，有一个词不断地蹦出来。

sentences.en: I hear him say this word again and again, monafik, monafik, monafik.
sentences.zh: 我听到他一遍又一遍地重复这个词，monafik、monafik、monafik。

sentences.en: And monafik is a word that kind of means, at best, traitor.
sentences.zh: 而monafik这个词，往好了说大概意思是叛徒。

sentences.en: At worst, it means a fake Muslim.
sentences.zh: 往坏了说，它意味着假穆斯林。

sentences.en: Someone who's saying he's a Muslim, but is basically not a Muslim.
sentences.zh: 一个嘴上说自己是穆斯林，但实际上根本不是穆斯林的人。

sentences.en: And I realize they're talking about me.
sentences.zh: 我意识到他们在谈论我。

sentences.en: Nafis knew that for some Muslims with extremist views, being a fake Muslim was a sin punishable by death.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯知道，对于某些持有极端主义观点的穆斯林来说，假穆斯林是会被判处死刑的罪过。

sentences.en: Frightened for his life, he tried to figure out how to escape.
sentences.zh: 由于担心自己的生命安全，他开始琢磨该怎么逃跑。

sentences.en: He could not exit through the front door without alerting the three men in the next room.
sentences.zh: 他不惊动隔壁房间的那三个男人，就没法从前门出去。

sentences.en: It was at that moment he remembered a story that Scott Atron had told him.
sentences.zh: 就在那个时候，他想起了一则斯科特·阿特兰曾对他说过的事。

sentences.en: When he was in Indonesia, he got into a bit of trouble with some jihadis there.
sentences.zh: 当斯科特在印度尼西亚时，他在那里跟一些圣战分子惹上了一点麻烦。

sentences.en: And now he had to jump out of a window while he was using the bathroom to get out of that situation.
sentences.zh: 当时他为了摆脱那种处境，不得不在上厕所时从窗户跳出去。

sentences.en: I'm glad I had that conversation with him.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴当时曾和他有过那番交谈。

sentences.en: Because that is what caused me at that moment to look out and see that there's a window in this room.
sentences.zh: 因为正是那次交谈，让我在此刻向外张望，并看到这个房间里有一扇窗户。

sentences.en: There was only one problem.
sentences.zh: 只有一个问题。

sentences.en: He couldn't just jump out the window like Scott had done, because this apartment was on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 他不能像斯科特那样直接跳窗逃跑，因为这套公寓在二楼。

sentences.en: Nafis opened the window and saw there was a narrow ledge outside.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯打开窗户，看到外面有一个狭窄的窗台。

sentences.en: Terrified by the men in the next room, he stepped out onto the ledge.
sentences.zh: 由于害怕隔壁房间的男人，他踏上了窗台。

sentences.en: I'm hanging on the ledge of the side of this building.
sentences.zh: 我正挂在这栋大楼外侧的窗台上。

sentences.en: There's an awning of like a store or something underneath me.
sentences.zh: 我下方是一个商店什么的遮阳篷。

sentences.en: I just momentarily balance my foot on the awning.
sentences.zh: 我让脚在遮阳篷上短暂地平衡了一下。

sentences.en: But immediately the awning kind of cracks.
sentences.zh: 但遮阳篷瞬间就裂开了。

sentences.en: So I fall.
sentences.zh: 所以我掉了下去。

sentences.en: But I fall into the awning, which mostly broke my fall.
sentences.zh: 但我掉在了遮阳篷上，这在很大程度上缓冲了我的下坠。

sentences.en: I completely shattered the awning.
sentences.zh: 我把遮阳篷彻底砸碎了。

sentences.en: Luckily, I didn't hit the ground too hard.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我落地时撞得不算太重。

sentences.en: And I was able to just get basically just as soon as I got my feet on the ground,
sentences.zh: 我基本上刚一站稳脚跟，

sentences.en: I just ran to the train station as fast as I could.
sentences.zh: 就以最快的速度朝火车站跑去。

sentences.en: And stupidly, when I get to the train station, I realize like the next train is in an hour and 27 minutes.
sentences.zh: 愚蠢的是，当我到达火车站时，我发现下一班火车要在一个小时零27分钟后开出。

sentences.en: I'm like, OK, this is not the right move.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，这招可真不走运。

sentences.en: But luckily, there was a taxi outside.
sentences.zh: 但幸运的是，外面停着一辆出租车。

sentences.en: So I got into the taxi and told him to go towards Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 于是我上了出租车，告诉司机往巴塞罗那方向开。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So this was this was your introduction to trying to find these people.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是，这就是你尝试去寻找这些人的初尝苦果。

sentences.en: This didn't dissuade you at this point from saying, you know, maybe I should go back to acting.
sentences.zh: 这时候这并没有打消你的念头，让你觉得，你知道的，也许我该回去演戏。

sentences.en: I mean, it's all acting, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这全都是演戏，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, but I mean, it's like it's it's I mean, this I wanted adventures, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，但我的意思是，这就好像是，我是说，我当时想要冒险，对吧？

sentences.en: I wanted excitement.
sentences.zh: 我想要刺激。

sentences.en: I wanted to you know, I didn't I didn't want stunt doubles.
sentences.zh: 我想要，你知道的，我不想要替身。

sentences.en: I wanted to be my own stunt double.
sentences.zh: 我想做自己的特技替身。

sentences.en: So here I was, you know, getting what I asked for.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时就在这里，你知道的，自食其果了。

sentences.en: When we come back, Nafis finds a slightly more boring, but also less dangerous way to talk to extremists.
sentences.zh: 当我们回来时，纳菲斯将寻找一种稍微枯燥一些，但危险性也更小的方式来与极端分子对话。

sentences.en: You're listening to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 您正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantar.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantar.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Nafis Hamid is a cognitive scientist at King's College London.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯·哈米德是伦敦国王学院的认知科学家。

sentences.en: As a young doctoral student, he wanted to identify what factors push people to become violent extremists.
sentences.zh: 作为一名年轻的博士生，他想要找出究竟是什么因素促使人们成为暴力极端分子。

sentences.en: While conducting research in Barcelona, his first few attempts to find volunteers to take part in his studies failed.
sentences.zh: 在巴塞罗那进行研究期间，他最初几次寻找志愿者参与其研究的尝试都失败了。

sentences.en: But he did eventually discover a better way to connect with radicalized Muslim men.
sentences.zh: 但他最终确实发现了一种与激进穆斯林男性建立联系的更好方法。

sentences.en: One of the best ways was to use a fixer, someone from the area who was already trusted by the communities, could speak their languages and understood their cultural norMs.
sentences.zh: 最好的方法之一就是使用中间人，也就是当地那些已经获得社区信任、能说他们的语言并理解其文化规范的人。

sentences.en: Nafis found a few young men who fit the bill and hired them as research assistants.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯找到了几个符合条件的年轻人，并雇用他们作为研究助理。

sentences.en: One of them especially stood out.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人尤其引人注目。

sentences.en: And at first, I wasn't sure whether he was going to be a good research assistant or not, just because he didn't have a university degree or anything.
sentences.zh: 起初，我并不确定他能不能成为一个好的研究助理，因为他没有大学学位什么的。

sentences.en: He didn't even have like a normal high school diploma.
sentences.zh: 他甚至连普通的高中毕业证都没有。

sentences.en: But turned out he was amazing.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明他太棒了。

sentences.en: I mean, he spoke something like six languages fluently, very charismatic, full of personality, had big dreams and ambitions, wanted to be a professional athlete,
sentences.zh: 我是说，他能流利地讲大概六种语言，非常有个人魅力，个性十足，有着宏大的梦想和抱负，想成为一名职业运动员，

sentences.en: wanted to be a musician, wanted to go into the arts.
sentences.zh: 想成为一名音乐家，想涉足艺术领域。

sentences.en: After meeting me, he wanted to be a researcher, just a really charismatic individual.
sentences.zh: 在遇到我之后，他想成为一名研究员，简直是一个极具个人魅力的人。

sentences.en: And he knew everyone.
sentences.zh: 而且他认识所有人。

sentences.en: And so he and I, together in the beginning, started to go out and meet people.
sentences.zh: 因此，起初我和他一起开始外出结识人们。

sentences.en: And he would introduce me to the right kinds of characters.
sentences.zh: 他会把我介绍给合适类型的人物。

sentences.en: And then it kind of just snowballs from there.
sentences.zh: 然后事情就像滚雪球一样发展起来了。

sentences.en: You kind of get eventually more and more extremist people.
sentences.zh: 你最终会接触到越来越多极端主义倾向的人。

sentences.en: They focused on recruiting volunteers from Moroccan and Pakistani immigrant communities.
sentences.zh: 他们专注于从摩洛哥和巴基斯坦移民社区招募志愿者。

sentences.en: To Nafis' surprise, many young men were excited about the possibility of having their brains scanned.
sentences.zh: 令纳菲斯惊讶的是，许多年轻人对自己的大脑被扫描充满了兴趣。

sentences.en: People found that interesting, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，人们觉得这很有趣。

sentences.en: You know, even when I got to the most extreme people, the most radicalized people, who were openly telling me about their support for Al-Qaeda or for other groups.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，甚至当我接触到那些最极端的人、最激进的人时，他们也会公开向我倾诉他们对基地组织或其他组织的支持。

sentences.en: When they would hear that, they became curious.
sentences.zh: 当他们听到这个时，他们变得好奇起来。

sentences.en: They wanted to know more about, well, what does previous neuroscience say?
sentences.zh: 他们想了解更多关于，嗯，先前的神经科学是怎么说的？

sentences.en: Like, what are your hypotheses about this?
sentences.zh: 比如说，你对此有什么假设？

sentences.en: And then some of them also were a bit narcissistic, too.
sentences.zh: 然后他们其中一些人也多多少少有点自恋。

sentences.en: You know, they were like, oh, my brain is very special.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们会说，哦，我的大脑非常特别。

sentences.en: You're going to discover that.
sentences.zh: 你很快就会发现了。

sentences.en: Just wait until you see my brain.
sentences.zh: 等着瞧吧，等你看到我的大脑就知道了。

sentences.en: One guy was like, okay, fine, I will participate in your study, but only under one condition.
sentences.zh: 有个家伙说，好吧，行，我将参与你们的研究，但只有一个条件。

sentences.en: He kind of looks around like he's about to tell me something very secretive.
sentences.zh: 他环顾四周，好像正要告诉我什么非常机密的事情。

sentences.en: And he goes, I want a picture of my brain just to prove to my mother that I have one.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我想要一张我大脑的照片，好向我母亲证明我确实有一个大脑。

sentences.en: Nafis and his team conducted the first set of brain scans on a group of Moroccan men whose families had been living in Barcelona for a few generations.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯和他的团队对一组摩洛哥男性的第一批大脑进行了扫描，这些人的家族已经在巴塞罗那生活了好几代人。

sentences.en: These were men on the edge of radicalization, open about their willingness to fight or even die for their beliefs,
sentences.zh: 这些人处于激进化的边缘，他们毫不掩饰自己为了信仰而战甚至去死的意愿，

sentences.en: but who hadn't yet committed themselves to a group like ISIS or Al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 但他们尚未真正投身于像ISIS或基地组织这样的组织。

sentences.en: Nafis wanted to better understand what might prompt these men to make the leap to join extremist groups.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯想要更好地理解是什么促使这些人跨出那一步加入极端组织。

sentences.en: So he set up a video game called Cyberball, a virtual soccer game.
sentences.zh: 于是他设置了一个名为“赛博球”（Cyberball）的电子游戏，这是一个虚拟的足球游戏。

sentences.en: When a volunteer sat down to play, he'd see four avatars on the screen.
sentences.zh: 当志愿者坐下来开始玩时，他会在屏幕上看到四个虚拟形象。

sentences.en: One of them represents them.
sentences.zh: 其中一个代表他们自己。

sentences.en: It's their little avatar.
sentences.zh: 那是他们的小虚拟形象。

sentences.en: And then there's three other avatars of three other players.
sentences.zh: 然后还有其他三个玩家的三个虚拟形象。

sentences.en: They can see faces of those three players.
sentences.zh: 他们可以看到那三个玩家的面孔。

sentences.en: They look like Spanish or Catalan players.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来像是西班牙或加泰罗尼亚的玩家。

sentences.en: They have names underneath them that are very typical, stereotypical Catalan male names.
sentences.zh: 他们的名字下方是非常典型、带有刻板印象的加泰罗尼亚男性名字。

sentences.en: And they're told that these three players are three other real people who are sitting in rooms as well.
sentences.zh: 并且他们被告知这三个玩家是坐在房间里的另外三个真实的人。

sentences.en: So they think they're real people.
sentences.zh: 所以他们以为那是真人。

sentences.en: The task is simple.
sentences.zh: 任务很简单。

sentences.en: You're just going to press this little button on this computer, and you can pass the ball towards any of the other three players that you want to.
sentences.zh: 你只要按一下这台电脑上的这个小按钮，就可以把球传给你想传的另外三个玩家中的任何一个。

sentences.en: They'll then pass the ball back to you.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会把球传回给你。

sentences.en: Unknown to the participants, the other three avatars were not real players.
sentences.zh: 参与者们并不知道，另外三个虚拟形象并不是真正的玩家。

sentences.en: They were part of the experimental team.
sentences.zh: 他们是实验团队的成员。

sentences.en: Nafis had split the volunteers into two groups.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯将志愿者分成了两组。

sentences.en: The men in the first group would play the game for a while, just passing the ball back and forth with the other avatars.
sentences.zh: 第一组的男性会玩一会儿游戏，只跟其他虚拟形象来回传球。

sentences.en: But for the volunteers in the second group, things played out differently.
sentences.zh: 但对于第二组的志愿者来说，情况则有所不同。

sentences.en: They pass the ball to the other players.
sentences.zh: 他们把球传给其他玩家。

sentences.en: Maybe the ball gets passed to them once or twice.
sentences.zh: 也许球被传给他们了一两次。

sentences.en: But then the other players basically stopped tossing the ball back to them.
sentences.zh: 但接着其他玩家基本上就不再把球传回给他们了。

sentences.en: And the three ostensibly Spanish or Catalan players basically just start tossing the ball back and forth to each other.
sentences.zh: 那三个表面上是西班牙或加泰罗尼亚的玩家基本上开始只在彼此之间互相传球。

sentences.en: The Moroccan volunteer would be deliberately excluded from the game.
sentences.zh: 那个摩洛哥志愿者将被故意排除在游戏之外。

sentences.en: His avatar left standing with nothing to do but watch.
sentences.zh: 他的虚拟形象孤零零地站在那里，除了观看什么也做不了。

sentences.en: Once the volunteers had played the game, they were asked to get into an fMRI machine.
sentences.zh: 志愿者们玩完游戏后，被要求进入功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）机器中。

sentences.en: Just a big magnetic tube that they lay down in, they slide into it, and then they look up at a screen basically.
sentences.zh: 那只是一个他们躺在里面的巨大磁性圆管，他们滑入其中，基本上就是抬头看着一个屏幕。

sentences.en: And what they're seeing is a value.
sentences.zh: 他们看到的是一个数值。

sentences.en: These were not numerical values, but values that the volunteers had been surveyed on before.
sentences.zh: 这些不是数字，而是志愿者在此之前接受过问卷调查的价值观。

sentences.en: Non-sacred values, such as halal food, should be served in hospitals, jails, and schools.
sentences.zh: 非神圣价值观，比如清真食品应当在医院、监狱和学校供应。

sentences.en: Or sacred values, like Western military forces, should be expelled from Muslim lands.
sentences.zh: 或者神圣价值观，比如西方军事力量应当被驱逐出穆斯林土地。

sentences.en: Underneath the value, they then see a scale, a 1 to 7 scale.
sentences.zh: 在价值观下方，他们随后会看到一个量表，一个1到7的量表。

sentences.en: And that's a fight-and-die scale.
sentences.zh: 这是一个“战斗至死”的量表。

sentences.en: So for 1, it says, how much are you willing to do for this value?
sentences.zh: 所以对于1，上面写着，你愿意为这个价值观付出多少？

sentences.en: 1 being, I'm not willing to do anything at all.
sentences.zh: 1代表，我什么都不愿意做。

sentences.en: And then 7 being, I'm willing to fight and die.
sentences.zh: 然后7代表，我愿意为之战斗并牺牲。

sentences.en: Previous research that Nafis and other cognitive scientists had done had revealed a trend.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯和其他认知科学家先前所做研究揭示了一种趋势。

sentences.en: When someone was on the edge of radicalization, an experience of social exclusion would often push them over the edge.
sentences.zh: 当某人处于激进化的边缘时，被社会排斥的经历往往会把他们推向深渊。

sentences.en: The results of the Cyberball study mirrored this finding.
sentences.zh: 赛博球研究的结果呼应了这一发现。

sentences.en: Volunteers who were excluded during the virtual soccer game became more willing to fight and die for their sacred values,
sentences.zh: 在虚拟足球比赛中遭到排挤的志愿者，变得更愿意为他们的神圣价值观去抗争、去牺牲，

sentences.en: and for non-sacred values as well.
sentences.zh: 对非神圣价值观也是如此。

sentences.en: And not only that, we saw that behaviorally, when we retested people for their sacred, non-sacred values,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，我们在行为层面上发现，当我们对人们的神圣和非神圣价值观进行重新测试时，

sentences.en: more of the values that were previously labeled as non-sacred started to get categorized as sacred when they went through the psychometric tests.
sentences.zh: 在经历心理测量测试后，以前被归类为非神圣的价值观中，有更多开始被归类为神圣的价值观。

sentences.en: If a trivial act of exclusion in a video game could change how volunteers felt about serious issues,
sentences.zh: 如果电子游戏中微不足道的排挤行为就能改变志愿者对严肃问题的看法，

sentences.en: what might be the effect of more serious forms of exclusion in real life?
sentences.zh: 那么现实生活中更严重的排挤形式又会产生什么影响呢？

sentences.en: What I think is going on here, mixing in my qualitative observations and looking at other research,
sentences.zh: 结合我的定性观察以及对其他研究的审视，我认为这里发生的情况是，

sentences.en: is that when people feel, many of us hold multiple identities,
sentences.zh: 当人们感到——我们许多人都拥有多重身份，

sentences.en: and certainly second generation Moroccan youth in Spain are no different.
sentences.zh: 西班牙的第二代摩洛哥青年当然也不例外。

sentences.en: They hold multiple identities.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有多重身份。

sentences.en: They're Moroccan, they're Spanish, they're young, they're a Barca football team fan.
sentences.zh: 他们是摩洛哥人，是西班牙人，是年轻人，是巴萨足球队的球迷。

sentences.en: They associate with different political movements as well.
sentences.zh: 他们也与不同的政治运动有联系。

sentences.en: When you feel rejected by a particular group, especially if it's the majority group,
sentences.zh: 当你感到被某个特定群体拒绝时，特别是当这个群体是多数群体时，

sentences.en: you're probably out of the different groups that you belong to,
sentences.zh: 在你所属的不同群体之外，

sentences.en: you're going to find solace in that one group that actually presents itself as your defender,
sentences.zh: 你可能会在那个真正将自己表现为你的保护者的群体中找到慰藉，

sentences.en: as the group that is there to get your back, to be your fellow gang members,
sentences.zh: 也就是那个在你背后支持你、作为你的同伙、

sentences.en: to protect you against that group that just rejected you.
sentences.zh: 保护你免受刚刚排挤你的那个群体伤害的群体。

sentences.en: That group is now going to gain an attraction a lot more.
sentences.zh: 那个群体现在将获得大得多的吸引力。

sentences.en: I mean, in some ways, this speaks to sort of the deep-rooted need we all have to find acceptance.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从某种程度上说，这说明了我们所有人内心深处对寻找认同感的强烈需求。

sentences.en: So in some ways, when we don't have acceptance in one area of our lives,
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，当我们生活的某个领域得不到认同感时，

sentences.en: it's perhaps not irrational that we will seek acceptance in another area of our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们在生活的另一个领域寻求认同感，也许并非不理智。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think belonging is just one of those sort of very basic human needs.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为归属感只是人类那种非常基本的原始需求之一。

sentences.en: As social animals, it's where we feel safeSt.
sentences.zh: 作为社会性动物，这是我们感到安全的地方。

sentences.en: You know, evolutionarily, if we're as a lone animal out there in the wilderness,
sentences.zh: 你知道，从进化角度来看，如果我们像荒野中的独行动物一样，

sentences.en: we're in huge danger.
sentences.zh: 我们就会处于极大的危险之中。

sentences.en: Social exclusion isn't the only thing that pushes people toward extremism.
sentences.zh: 社会排挤并不是把人们推向极端主义的唯一原因。

sentences.en: Nafis and other researchers have noted that it's often a cascade of life events
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯和其他研究人员指出，这通常是一连串的生活事件

sentences.en: combined with an experience of social exclusion that leads to radicalization.
sentences.zh: 加上社会排挤的经历，最终导致了激进化。

sentences.en: He witnessed this firsthand while working with that charismatic research assistant
sentences.zh: 他在与那位富有个人魅力的研究助理共事时亲眼见证了这一点，

sentences.en: who had helped him find volunteers for the brain imaging study.
sentences.zh: 正是这位助理曾帮他为脑成像研究寻找志愿者。

sentences.en: So I think he, in the beginning, sort of saw me as a little bit of like an older brother figure.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他一开始有点把我当成一个老大哥似的人物。

sentences.en: And he wanted to share all of his passions with me and all of his big goals that he had in his life
sentences.zh: 他想与我分享他所有的热情，分享他在生活中所有的宏伟目标，

sentences.en: and how he really wanted to become somebody.
sentences.zh: 以及他多么渴望干出一番成就。

sentences.en: But then over the course of our fieldwork, he started to, I could just see,
sentences.zh: 但随后在我们的实地调查过程中，我能明显看出，

sentences.en: kind of go into a darker and darker place.
sentences.zh: 他开始陷入一种越来越黑暗的境地。

sentences.en: In the beginning, I could just kind of see it in his mood and his energy.
sentences.zh: 起初，我从他的情绪和精力中就能隐约察觉到这一点。

sentences.en: And a lot of it started off with issues that he was having with his father,
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上始于他与父亲之间的问题，

sentences.en: who basically just wanted him to go get a job to help support the family,
sentences.zh: 他父亲基本上只想让他去找份工作来补贴家用，

sentences.en: some kind of menial work, and really denigrated his high-minded ambitions.
sentences.zh: 做一些卑微的体力活，并且极力贬低他那些高远的大志。

sentences.en: Then he had a best friend whose life went into like a very negative direction,
sentences.zh: 接着，他的一位挚友的生活走向了非常消极的方向，

sentences.en: and he basically lost contact with his best friend.
sentences.zh: 他基本与这位挚友失去了联系。

sentences.en: So he started to feel more alone because of that.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，他开始感到更加孤独。

sentences.en: The punches just kept coming.
sentences.zh: 打击接踵而至。

sentences.en: Next, his family found out that he had secretly been dating a Spanish woman who wasn't Muslim
sentences.zh: 接下来，他的家人发现他一直在秘密约会一位非穆斯林的西班牙女性，

sentences.en: and forced them to break up.
sentences.zh: 并强迫他们分手。

sentences.en: And he told me that he was just walking around Barcelona all the time
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他有时会在巴塞罗那四处闲逛，

sentences.en: until 3 a.m.
sentences.zh: 一直逛到凌晨

sentences.en: in the morning sometimes, chain-smoking.
sentences.zh: 三点，烟不离手。

sentences.en: And he would be watching videos a lot, and he couldn't sleep, and he had insomnia,
sentences.zh: 而且他经常看视频，失眠睡不着觉，

sentences.en: and I could tell he was kind of getting into a depressed state.
sentences.zh: 我能看出他正陷入一种抑郁的状态。

sentences.en: And then, over time, he started talking about some political issues,
sentences.zh: 随后，随着时间的推移，他开始谈论一些政治问题，

sentences.en: and I could see that there was this bubbling sympathy for extremist groups.
sentences.zh: 我能看出他对极端主义群体产生了一种萌芽状态的同情。

sentences.en: He'd be talking about the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 他会谈论塔利班。

sentences.en: And he'd be saying how the Taliban are being bombed on Pakistani soil by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他会说塔利班如何在巴基斯坦领土上遭到美国政府的轰炸，

sentences.en: government,
sentences.zh: 以及这些人是我们的同胞，你知道的，我们本该跟他们对话。

sentences.en: and how these are our people, and this is, you know, we should be talking to them.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始谈论前往叙利亚的外国战斗人员，

sentences.en: And then he started talking about foreign fighters going to Syria,
sentences.zh: 还说，你知道的，当外国战斗人员来到西班牙时，

sentences.en: and how, you know, when foreign fighters came to Spain,
sentences.zh: 他们被视为英雄。

sentences.en: they were considered heroes.
sentences.zh: 而当他们前往叙利亚时，他们却被视为叛徒，

sentences.en: When they were going to Syria, they were considered traitors,
sentences.zh: 可能仅仅因为他们是穆斯林，这就是伪善。

sentences.en: probably because they're just Muslims, so this is hypocrisy.
sentences.zh: 接着他们开始向我展示他一直在看的视频，

sentences.en: And they started showing me videos that he was watching,
sentences.zh: 其中一些是关于伊斯兰国如何在叙利亚开设学校和医院的宣传视频。

sentences.en: and some of them were ISIS propaganda videos about how ISIS was opening up schools and hospitals in Syria.
sentences.zh: 而这些内容你在主流媒体上是永远看不到的。

sentences.en: And this is the stuff you never see in the mainstream media.
sentences.zh: 这就是这帮人在实地真正做的事情。

sentences.en: This is what these guys are actually doing on the ground.
sentences.zh: 所以我意识到我必须进行干预。

sentences.en: And so I realized I have to intervene.
sentences.zh: 我必须做点什么。

sentences.en: I have to do something.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯请他的研究助理在该市一个移民社区的林荫长廊见面。

sentences.en: Nafis asked his research assistant to meet in a tree-lined promenade in an immigrant neighborhood of the city.
sentences.zh: 他在长椅上等啊等，等了又等。

sentences.en: He waited on a bench and waited and waited.
sentences.zh: 首先，他迟到了很久，这同样很不符合他的作风。

sentences.en: First of all, he shows up very late, which, again, is not like him.
sentences.zh: 但他确实迟到了很久，我记得我从远处看到他向我走来，

sentences.en: But he shows up very late, and I remember seeing him from a distance walking over to me,
sentences.zh: 双肩下垂，双手插在口袋里，

sentences.en: shoulders slumped, hands in his pockets,
sentences.zh: 简直就像是我记忆中那个充满人格魅力的年轻人的空壳。

sentences.en: just kind of a shell of the guy that I remember with so much charisma.
sentences.zh: 他知道我想跟他谈谈关于他一直向我展示的那些内容的事。

sentences.en: And he knows I want to talk to him about something related to what he's been showing me.
sentences.zh: 他走过来，坐在我旁边的长椅上。

sentences.en: And he comes, and he sits next to me on the bench.
sentences.zh: 他的双臂交叉在胸前。

sentences.en: His arms are crossed.
sentences.zh: 甚至没有怎么看着我。

sentences.en: He's not even really looking at me.
sentences.zh: 目光有点投向了其他方向。

sentences.en: He's kind of looking off in the other direction.
sentences.zh: 我开始对他说，你知道的，你看的这些视频太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And I just start telling him, you know, these videos you're watching, these are crazy.
sentences.zh: 这是宣传洗脑。

sentences.en: This is propaganda.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在利用你。

sentences.en: They're just taking advantage of you.
sentences.zh: 你根本不明白这些人是什么货色。

sentences.en: You don't even understand who these people are.
sentences.zh: 这些是恐怖组织。

sentences.en: These are terrorist groups.
sentences.zh: 他们是杀人犯。

sentences.en: They're murderers.
sentences.zh: 他们在滥杀无辜。

sentences.en: They're killing everyone.
sentences.zh: 他们完全是在给你洗脑，利用你脆弱的状态。

sentences.en: And they're just completely brainwashing you and taking advantage of your vulnerable state.
sentences.zh: 当你这么说时，他的反应是什么？

sentences.en: And what was his reaction when you said this?
sentences.zh: 他有没有说，谢谢你帮我走上正轨？

sentences.en: Did he say, thanks for setting me straight?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他一直把你当成大哥来看待。

sentences.en: I mean, he looked up to you as an older brother.
sentences.zh: 他有没有表现出那种“你让我看到了我以前没看到的东西”的反应？

sentences.en: Did he have the reaction of basically saying, you've shown me something that I hadn't seen?
sentences.zh: 他试图安抚我。

sentences.en: He tried to placate me.
sentences.zh: 我说话时，他只是盯着地面。

sentences.en: He just stared down at the ground while I was talking.
sentences.zh: 他点着头听我说话，但并没有真正看着我，也没有把我的话听进去。

sentences.en: He was nodding his head, listening to me, but not really looking at me, not really taking in what I was saying.
sentences.zh: 他只是用一种连当时的我都不太相信的语气说，谢谢你，纳菲斯·派。

sentences.en: And he just kind of, in a way that even I didn't quite believe at the time, just said, thank you, Nafis Pai.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: I understand.
sentences.zh: 我明白你的意思了。

sentences.en: I understand what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 然后他基本上同意我们重新开始实地调查。

sentences.en: And then he just basically agreed that we would pick up the fieldwork again.
sentences.zh: 我们过几天就恢复。

sentences.en: We would do it in a few days.
sentences.zh: 他说，谢谢你。

sentences.en: And he said, thank you.
sentences.zh: 然后他就站起身，径直走开了。

sentences.en: And then he just got up and just walked away.
sentences.zh: 他甚至都没有回头看我一眼什么的。

sentences.en: He didn't really even turn to me or anything.
sentences.zh: 他直接站起来，朝着他来的方向走回去了。

sentences.en: He just stood right up and just walked back towards where he came from.
sentences.zh: 随后，这位研究助理切断了与纳菲斯的一切联系。

sentences.en: And then the research assistant broke off all contact with Nafis.
sentences.zh: 我给他发了信息。

sentences.en: I sent him messages.
sentences.zh: 我问他，你知道的，我们还要见面吗？

sentences.en: I was asking him, you know, are we going to meet up?
sentences.zh: 我尝试给他打电话。

sentences.en: I tried to call him.
sentences.zh: 我发现他的电话已经停机了。

sentences.en: I realized the phone had been disconnected.
sentences.zh: 我们在社交媒体上互相关注。

sentences.en: We were following each other on social media.
sentences.zh: 于是我去查看他的社交媒体个人资料，发现那个账号基本上已经被注销了。

sentences.en: So I went and checked a social media profile and I saw that the user had been deleted, essentially.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我担心最坏的情况发生。

sentences.en: And, you know, I feared the worSt.
sentences.zh: 我的脑海里开始浮现：他是不是跑去加入某个组织了？

sentences.en: My mind goes into the direction of, did he go off and join a group or something?
sentences.zh: 或者是去了叙利亚？

sentences.en: Or go to Syria?
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯曾考虑过追踪这名研究助理的下落，但他不知道对方住在哪里。

sentences.en: Nafis considered trying to track the research assistant down, but he didn't know where he lived.
sentences.zh: 于是他尝试了另一种途径。

sentences.en: So he tried an alternate route.
sentences.zh: 他去找了这位助理的一个表亲，想打听点消息。

sentences.en: He went to one of the assistant's cousins to do some digging for him.
sentences.zh: 那个人说，好吧，他会去调查一下。

sentences.en: That guy says, OK, he'll do some investigation.
sentences.zh: 他不想在电话里跟我谈。

sentences.en: He didn't want to talk to me on the phone.
sentences.zh: 他说，你一个星期后再来吧。

sentences.en: He said, just come back one week later.
sentences.zh: 所以在整整一个星期里，我简直如坐针毡，你知道的，这是比喻意。

sentences.en: So for a whole week, I'm just kind of sweating bullets, you know, metaphorically speaking.
sentences.zh: 就像，我真的不知道发生了什么，他到底怎么了。

sentences.en: Like, I just don't really know what's going on, what happened to him.
sentences.zh: 我回来和那个表亲见面，他基本上告诉我，父母不知怎么发现了他的情况。

sentences.en: I come back and I meet with the cousin and he tells me basically that the parents sort of found out what was going on with him.
sentences.zh: 然后父母基本上说，好吧，我们可以送你出国到另一个西方国家，你在那里一个家族熟人的企业里找份工作，做兼职，

sentences.en: And then the parents basically said, OK, we can send you abroad to another Western country where you can get a job at a family acquaintances business, work part time,
sentences.zh: 把一部分钱寄回给我们。

sentences.en: send some of that money back to us.
sentences.zh: 这样你在那里就可以继续追求你那些更宏大的抱负了。

sentences.en: And then you can pursue some of your grander ambitions that you have while you're there.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，我们能拿到需要的钱，而你也能继续追求你想追求的事物。

sentences.en: So that way we get the money that we need and you can still pursue the things you want to pursue.
sentences.zh: 据推测，这就是他后来离家去做的事情。

sentences.en: And supposedly that's what he that's what he went off and did.
sentences.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，他的父母做了纳菲斯本该做的事。

sentences.en: Ironically, the parents did what Nafis should have done.
sentences.zh: 他们没有试图说服这个年轻人说他的信仰是错的，而是为他提供了一个去追逐梦想的机会。

sentences.en: Instead of trying to convince the young man that his beliefs were wrong, they offered him an opportunity to chase his dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 一旦那些寻找人生目标、意义以及真正融入生活和梦想的途径，一旦这些途径重新向他敞开，

sentences.en: As soon as those pathways for purpose and meaning and really inclusion in terms of his life and his dreams, once those pathways opened back up to him again,
sentences.zh: 他就放弃了对激进化的一时冲动，转而去追求自己的抱负。

sentences.en: he dropped his flirtation with radicalization and went off and pursued his ambitions.
sentences.zh: 节目回归后，纳菲斯将为我们揭示更多可用于遏制激进化蔓延的方法。

sentences.en: When we come back, Nafis discovers more methods we can use to deter the spread of radicalization.
sentences.zh: 他对我说，纳菲斯，我无法生活在那个世界里。

sentences.en: And he said to me, he goes, Nafis, I can't live in that world.
sentences.zh: 那个世界让我感到焦虑。

sentences.en: That world gives me anxiety.
sentences.zh: QAnon（匿名者Q）的世界，即使它是错的，至少它告诉我坏人在哪里。

sentences.en: The world of QAnon, even if it's wrong, it at least tells me where the bad guy is.
sentences.zh: 它为我指明了枪口应该对准的方向。

sentences.en: It gives me a direction of which way to point my gun.

sentences.en: and seemed like he had seen a lot of stress in his life.
sentences.zh: 我知道不要对他说你错了。

sentences.en: And the initial conversation was a bit stilted.
sentences.zh: 我知道如果你这样做，他只会退缩到自己的防御工事里。

sentences.en: He was a bit ideological.
sentences.zh: 相反，我问他最近怎么样。

sentences.en: But at this point, I had actually had so much experience talking to people with ideas that are very different than my own.
sentences.zh: 我问他生活过得怎么样。

sentences.en: I really knew how to navigate the situation, which was just to ask a lot of questions and for him to feel like he's being heard.
sentences.zh: 我真的很清楚如何应对这种情况，那就是多问问题，让他觉得自己被倾听了。

sentences.en: And he eventually revealed to me his whole journey down the QAnon rabbit hole and even into more far-right-wing ideology.
sentences.zh: 最终，他向我倾吐了他陷入QAnon深渊乃至更极端右翼思想的整个心路历程。

sentences.en: And what basically ended up happening was that he had a series of sort of events that happened in his life.
sentences.zh: 基本上发生的情况是，他的生活中接连发生了一系列事件。

sentences.en: Losing his job, relationship, breaking up, family members, loved ones, dying.
sentences.zh: 失业、恋爱破裂、分手、亲人离世。

sentences.en: And it all happened in very short order.
sentences.zh: 这一切都在很短的时间内接踵而至。

sentences.en: And this really created a sense of being lost in his life.
sentences.zh: 这确实让他的生活产生了一种迷失感。

sentences.en: Because all the things that gave him a sense of who he was and a sense of stability were just sort of stripped away from him in quite short order.
sentences.zh: 因为所有那些让他感知自我以及感到稳定感的事物，在很短的时间内就被剥夺了。

sentences.en: Unemployed, lonely, and stuck at home during the pandemic, Nafis' friend had started spending a lot of time on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯的这位朋友失业、孤独，在疫情期间被困在家中，开始在YouTube上花大量时间。

sentences.en: It began with popular alt-right channels, which led to conspiracy theory videos, and eventually to QAnon.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于热门的右翼替代频道，接着是阴谋论视频，最后演变成了QAnon。

sentences.en: QAnon gave him a bad guy.
sentences.zh: QAnon给他提供了一个坏人。

sentences.en: It gave him a bad guy that could just be responsible for all the world's probleMs.
sentences.zh: 它给他提供了一个可以为世界上所有问题负责的坏人。

sentences.en: At the end of like a 10-hour conversation, I could tell that he understood that I didn't understand really what was motivating him.
sentences.zh: 在进行了长达10小时的对话后，我能看出他明白我其实并不理解是什么在驱使他。

sentences.en: And so he sat there and he goes, OK, let me try to figure myself out with you.
sentences.zh: 于是他坐在那里对我说：“好吧，让我试着跟你一起把我自己理清楚。”

sentences.en: And he says to me, he goes, listen, my family were preppers.
sentences.zh: 他对我说：“听着，我的家人是末日生存狂。”

sentences.en: We had like 10 guns, 10,000 rounds of ammunition, and enough food and water for us to survive the zombie apocalypse if it came along.
sentences.zh: 我们大概有10把枪、1万发子弹，还有足够的食物和水，足够我们在僵尸末日降临的时候生存下来。

sentences.en: I'm an anxious person.
sentences.zh: 我是一个容易焦虑的人。

sentences.en: I can't handle uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 我无法应对不确定性。

sentences.en: I need a contingency plan for everything.
sentences.zh: 我需要为每件事制定应急计划。

sentences.en: And he said to me, he goes, Nafis, if there's no real good guys or bad guys, there's no one person who's creating all the trouble in the world.
sentences.zh: 他对我说：“纳菲斯，如果没有真正的好人或坏人，没有哪一个人在制造世间所有的麻烦。”

sentences.en: It's just, it's kind of chaotic.
sentences.zh: 事情其实就是，它有点混乱。

sentences.en: You know, you have this chaos theory.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你遇到了这种混沌理论。

sentences.en: You have all these different power players all trying to do their own thing.
sentences.zh: 你有所有这些不同的实力派都在试图做他们自己的事情。

sentences.en: And then sort of things emerge out of that complex interaction.
sentences.zh: 然后各种事情就从这种复杂的互动中涌现出来。

sentences.en: He goes, even if that's the way the world is, I can't live in that world.
sentences.zh: 他说：“即使世界就是这样的，我也无法生活在那个世界里。”

sentences.en: That world gives me anxiety.
sentences.zh: 那个世界让我感到焦虑。

sentences.en: The world of QAnon, even if it's wrong, it at least tells me where the bad guy is.
sentences.zh: 而QAnon的世界，即使它是错的，至少它告诉我坏人在哪里。

sentences.en: It gives me a direction of which way to point my gun.
sentences.zh: 它给我指明了枪口应该指向的方向。

sentences.en: In essence, it gives him a map to a territory.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，它为他提供了一张通往现实的地图。

sentences.en: And so he can navigate that world more easily.
sentences.zh: 这样他就能更轻松地在那个世界中航行了。

sentences.en: Although this was unsettling, Nafis just kept having open conversations with his friend.
sentences.zh: 尽管这让人感到不安，但纳菲斯还是不断与这位朋友进行坦诚的对话。

sentences.en: He wanted to give him a space outside the radical world of QAnon where he could feel understood,
sentences.zh: 他想为他提供一个远离QAnon激进世界、能让他感到被理解的空间，

sentences.en: where he could feel like he belonged.
sentences.zh: 一个能让他感受到归属感的地方。

sentences.en: These conversations lasted hours.
sentences.zh: 这些对话持续了几个小时。

sentences.en: Nafis gained his friend's trust, going so far as to become what psychologists call a credible messenger.
sentences.zh: 纳菲斯赢得了朋友的信任，甚至成为了心理学家所说的“可信信使”。

sentences.en: Credible messenger needs to have at least two qualities.
sentences.zh: 可信信使需要具备至少两种品质。

sentences.en: One is a perception of benevolence, that this person has my best interests at heart.
sentences.zh: 一是善意感，即这个人是真心为我的最大利益着想的。

sentences.en: And two, that this person has authority, that they know more about the topic than I do.
sentences.zh: 二是权威性，即他们在该主题上的了解比我更多。

sentences.en: And I knew from his eyes, he saw me as having both of those qualities.
sentences.zh: 从他的眼神中我知道，他认为我具备这两种品质。

sentences.en: So he respected me and he knew that I respected him as a person.
sentences.zh: 所以他尊重我，他也知道我作为一个人尊重他。

sentences.en: And so I became a credible messenger for him where we would have these conversations where he would post something that was clearly a conspiracy ideology-based thinking or what I would consider sometimes hate-mongering messages,
sentences.zh: 因此，我成了他的可信信使，我们会进行这样的对话：当他发布明显基于阴谋论思想的内容，或者有时被我认为是煽动仇恨的信息时，

sentences.en: us-versus-them, divisive messages, sometimes with undertones of anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 那种“我们对他们”、制造分裂的信息，有时还带有反犹太主义的潜台词，

sentences.en: But I knew that as the credible messenger in his life, I could, in a nice way, in a polite way, in a respectful way, engage with him about it and say,
sentences.zh: 但我知道，作为他生活中的可信信使，我可以以一种友好、礼貌、尊重的方式与他探讨这件事，并对他说：

sentences.en: listen, I don't think this message is quite true, because look at this alternative information.
sentences.zh: “听着，我觉得这个消息不太真实，因为你看这些另类的资讯。”

sentences.en: And because I had brought him in and became sort of one source of inclusion for him, he was open to what I was saying.
sentences.zh: 正因为我将他接纳进来，成了他的一种包容来源，所以他对我所说的话持开放态度。

sentences.en: Over time, the friend became more and more willing to have Nafis challenge his extremist beliefs.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这位朋友越来越愿意让纳菲斯去挑战他的极端主义信仰。

sentences.en: He posted less and less.
sentences.zh: 他发帖越来越少。

sentences.en: He got a girlfriend who didn't support his radical ideas, and with Nafis' encouragement, pursued a new line of work.
sentences.zh: 他交了一个不支持他激进想法的女朋友，并在纳菲斯的鼓励下开始从事新的工作。

sentences.en: Q became a thing of his paSt.
sentences.zh: Q（Anon）成了他过去的事情。

sentences.en: Most people don't want to say or even admit to themselves that they believed in something that perhaps they don't agree with anymore, but they just simply walk away from it,
sentences.zh: 大多数人都不愿说出来，甚至不愿向自己承认他们曾经相信过某些他们现在可能不再认同的东西，他们只是默默地走开，

sentences.en: and they just move on with other things in their life.
sentences.zh: 然后继续他们生活中的其他事情。

sentences.en: They don't want to talk about it anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们再也不想谈论它了。

sentences.en: And I would say he's kind of more in that phase.
sentences.zh: 我想说他现在更多地处于那个阶段。

sentences.en: I have to say, though, you know, the model that you're suggesting here, it's such a difficult model for many people to practice, right?
sentences.zh: 不过我必须说，你知道，你在这里提出的这种模式，对许多人来说是一个很难实践的模式，对吧？

sentences.en: Because if someone does something that we find not just wrong, but deeply offensive, deeply hurtful, that angers us,
sentences.zh: 因为如果有人做出了一件我们不仅觉得错误，而且深深感到被冒犯、深深受到伤害、让我们感到愤怒的事情，

sentences.en: it's very hard to remember that our ability to influence them comes down to their being able to trust us,
sentences.zh: 我们很难记住，我们影响他们的能力归根结底取决于他们是否能够信任我们，

sentences.en: and therefore we should actually reach out to them and make them feel included when everything in our body is screaming to us to exclude them.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们的身体本能在疯狂叫嚣着将他们排除在外时，我们实际上应该向他们伸出援手，让他们感受到被包容。

sentences.en: Yeah, and you have to remember, are you doing this for you or are you doing this for them, all right?
sentences.zh: 是的，你必须记住，你这样做是为了你自己，还是为了他们，对吧？

sentences.en: Because sometimes it can feel personally cathartic and feel good to get upset at them, and sometimes it's almost we don't realize it,
sentences.zh: 因为有时对他们发火会让人感到个人的宣泄并且感觉良好，有时我们甚至没有意识到，

sentences.en: but maybe we're even being a bit performative in our anger because this is what our in-group would think is the righteous way,
sentences.zh: 但也许我们在愤怒中甚至带有一点表演性质，因为这是我们的内群体认为正义的方式，

sentences.en: and the virtuous way to behave.
sentences.zh: 以及表现得高尚的方式。

sentences.en: And even if there's nobody else watching, we might be virtue signaling because we've just, you know, intrinsically hold these values now.
sentences.zh: 即使周围没有任何人在看，我们可能也只是在进行道德表态，因为我们现在（你知道的）内心已经笃信这些价值观了。

sentences.en: But it's not always going to be the useful and the right way to actually help navigate someone into a different pathway.
sentences.zh: 但这并不总是引导某人走向不同道路的有用且正确的方法。

sentences.en: If you want to transform another person's life, you have to really transform your relationship with them.
sentences.zh: 如果你想改变另一个人的生活，你必须真正改变你与他们的关系。

sentences.en: I think this is the big myth of individualism is we think that we can exist independently, but we don't.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是个人主义的一大误区，我们认为我们可以独立存在，但我们不能。

sentences.en: We only exist in relation to other people, and everyone else exists in relation to everyone else.
sentences.zh: 我们只有在与他人的关系中才存在，而其他所有人也都存在于与所有其他人的关系中。

sentences.en: And so if you want to transform an individual person, in some sense, you have to transform yourself as well.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你想改变某个个人，从某种意义上说，你也必须改变你自己。

sentences.en: You have to change the relationship and be open to the fact that not only are you going to maybe transform their way of thinking,
sentences.zh: 你必须改变这种关系，并对这种可能性保持开放：不仅你可能会改变他们的思维方式，

sentences.en: but maybe you'll also change in terms of having more empathy for them and hopefully even more compassion for them as well.
sentences.zh: 而且你可能也会改变，对他们产生更多的同理心，希望甚至能对他们产生更多的同情心。
